beginner.title: Everyday Essentials
beginner.description: Construct clear and confident communication through day-to-day scenarios spanning family life, hobbies, school, and routine conversations.

intermediate.title: Foundational Workplace Fluency
intermediate.description: Practice 20 core real-world workplace scenarios covering reading clarity, basic listening cadence, professional sentence construction, and routine speaking frameworks.

advanced.title: Executive Communication & Leadership
advanced.description: Master nuanced workplace negotiation, strategic stakeholder communication, complex passive/active structures, executive summary drafting, and high-impact verbal diplomacy.
